actual: Production read-only exact-key preflight on the frozen PIT universe (2022-01-01..2024-06-30, 601 trading dates) proves 466 daily_basic and 1093 moneyflow_ts apparent candidates. All 466 daily-basic dates are exact stock suspension dates and no DML candidate exists. C-009 source implementation resolves 591 moneyflow rows through immutable 302132.SZ -> 300114.SZ dataset-specific identity, preserves 502 provider-audit-bound absences as explicit NA, and resolves 348 causal circ_mv rows with maximum 30 market-trading-day staleness. The complete 601-day source-only preflight finished with no fits, selection, D6, model/READY, database write or runtime action, but correctly blocked on the existing train observation coverage contract: legacy L1=31/31 valid, legacy L2=130/131 valid with 801881.SI at 96 rows, autocycle L1=0/31 valid and autocycle L2=0/131 valid. No coverage threshold, rolling window, cross-section completeness, universe, hard semantic authority or model logic was changed.

description: The HMM B3 frozen stock-fact source has 466 exact daily_basic candidates and 1093 apparent moneyflow candidates. Read-only provider and lineage audit separates the moneyflow set into 591 historical rows present under predecessor code 300114.SZ for canonical code 302132.SZ, plus 502 rows absent from Tushare's own moneyflow authority. The guarded repair must enumerate every exact key, reject incomplete or mismatched provider identity, remain insert-only with canonical readback/idempotency/exact rollback, and keep alias semantics, production DML, training, selection, model/READY, database and runtime actions behind their existing separate authorization boundaries.

Confirmed all 466 daily-basic keys are suspension dates with no provider row, all 1093 moneyflow keys lack a same-identity provider row, and production DML has no legal candidate. Proposed C-009-A causal as-of circ_mv contract remains unapproved and unimplemented.

Approved C-009-A/B/C/D and expanded BUG-877 for the source-specific security resolver, causal circ_mv as-of, provider-absence NA evidence, and a 601-trading-day read-only preflight. Production DML, 5184 fits, selection, D6, model/READY, runtime actions, and source merge remain outside this authorization.

Implemented immutable security source identity, provider-absence NA evidence, causal circ_mv as-of, and bounded split-query execution. The 601-day read-only preflight completed with exact 591 alias, 502 provider absence and 348 stale circ_mv evidence, then failed closed because all four family/level train coverage receipts were not complete. No training, selection, D6, model/READY, DML or runtime action was executed.
